title: Adopt the better ordinary controller and retain its extra resources
statement: At g=1, Gamma=4, chi=2, T=8, eta=.5, q=.001, kb=kc=1e-4 and force caps 3, the equally informed conventional optimizer improves IB/N from .454999022 to .3216755211 and pZ from .000434314203 to .000307090844. This is a 29.3% reduction of one leakage functional. Source and corrector photon exposures rise from 4.53769 to 5.69834 and 8.64364 to 9.04222; corrector drive action rises from 14.52716 to 24.11421. The degree-30 cosine envelope reaches frequency 14.14g. An amplitude cap does not certify bandwidth, slew, DAC precision, distortion or a global optimum. The weighted zero-area clamped function f=exp[a(t-T/2)]A, the odd tan(z)=tanh(z) eigenvalue and the separately excluded lower even constrained eigenvalues yield the family-specific relaxed floor IB/N>=.3080159594/g. At a=5e-5g this gives pZ>=.0002940544, with the feasible pulse about 4.44% above the floor. This is not a bound for every architecture or an overall energy/time saving.
